mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 1.0% over 3 months, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in UNRATE above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDPC1 growth and HOUST below 1150 thousand units indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns as revenue expectations decline over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns when the correlation between series is below 0.5, or the Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5% annualized), central bank tightening to curb inflation reduces real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5% annualized, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS above 145,000 thousand units over 3 months strengthens consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 145,000 thousand units for 3 months, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening industrial output, reducing corporate production and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 3 months, or the Rank IC for INDPRO threshold is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 4.5% and decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.9% signals recessionary monetary response to labor market deterioration, triggering negative equity returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor deterioration
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns when the correlation between series is below 0.5, or the Rank IC for interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), housing market strength signals peak consumer spending leading to overvaluation and negative equity returns as the cycle nears contraction over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200 for 3 months, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
